notes: No official national or regional out-of-hours duty rota for companion animals was found: the Panhellenic Veterinary Association and regional associations (e.g. Attica) have no reachable public duty page, and the Ministry list (minagric.gr xlsx) is licensed for personal non-commercial use only, so it was not reused. Greece relies on private 24-h clinics: Attica (Plakentia Agia Paraskevi, Attikovet Paiania, Pikermi Animal Hospital, hospetal Kallithea, Modestos Nea Erythraia, Pawsitive Chalandri, Athens Vet Clinic Glyfada and Medic Animal Nea Smyrni on-call), Thessaloniki (AUTh university clinic weekday nights + weekends, Agios Modestos, Κτηνιατρικό Κέντρο Θεσσαλονίκης, Plakentia Thermi, Agathangelidis, ktiniatreio.net), Volos, Patras (on-call), Syros, Chania (Sirius, phone on-call). Duty rotas: only NGO-published out-of-hours numbers for Chania and Heraklion. Poison line: none for animals — the Greek Poison Centre (Κέντρο Δηλητηριάσεων, 210 7793777) is described only for human poisonings (no page found saying it advises on animals), so it is not listed as poison_line. Left / not covered: no 24-h clinic confirmed for Heraklion, Larissa, Ioannina, Kalamata, Rhodes or any Ionian island; Rethymno (rethymnovetclinic.gr, to-ktiniatrio.gr robots-disallowed), Agios Nikolaos/Lasithi, Kos, Kefalonia, Paros (fepvet.gr redirect loop), Halkidiki (only a Nea Moudania weekend duty vet for strays found in local news), Nafplio, Corinth, Tripoli, Lamia, Chalkida, Serres, Komotini, Chios, Samos and Karditsa (University of Thessaly clinic PDF robots-disallowed) have no entry. Unverified leads (named 24-h in NGO/blog lists, own site not reachable): Zoophilos 24h Pangrati (Filolaou 220), K. Anastopoulos Ilioupoli (24κτηνιατρειο.gr), A. Antonopoulos N. Filadelfeia/Patisia (nights 21-09 + weekends), Κτηνιατρικό Κέντρο Αγ. Στεφάνου, Papaioannou (vets.gr), Αμεση Κτηνιατρική Δράση Nikaia, Stavropoulos Korydallos, Liapis Chalandri. Also blocked/failed: sintosvet.gr (Ioannina), southparkvets.gr (Patras), lesvosvet.gr, corfuvet.gr, syrosvets.gr, dasmivet.gr / VET365 Heraklion (redirect loop), kontostolivet.gr (Kavala, server error), larissanet.gr. Aggregators seen but not used as sources: vetfinder.gr (contains placeholder numbers), vetsos.gr, hotelswithpets.com, vrisko.gr, xo.gr. Follow-up 2026-11-02: Follow-up run 2026-11-02 (Greece): added 45 entries; 8 with 24 h confirmed on their own pages (Gerakas KKG and Mantakas N. Irakleio in Attica, City Paws Thessaloniki, MyVet Larissa [site description only, no phone], Kontostoli Kavala [phone on-call], Marinou Chios [by phone arrangement], Vet Clinic of Pyrgos [phone on-call], Ktiniatriki Lamia [24-h emergency first aid]). Correction for an existing entry: Animal Zante (Zakynthos) own page https://animalzante.gr/gr_veterinary.php says 'Η 24ωρη διάθεση των υπηρεσιών μας' — its emergency_24h can be set to true (address Αγίου Λαζάρου 103; also 26950 45155, 6944 920 878). No duty rota found: no association/municipal page with a current rota (Pyrgos vets' weekend rota exists only as a 2020 newspaper article; Komotini rota articles on xronos.gr robots-disallowed, inkomotini.news and paratiritis-news.gr unreachable; Nea Propontida/Moudania weekend vet is a one-off municipal notice for strays). Municipal stray clinics seen but not listed (strays only): Agioi Anargyroi–Kamatero (agan.gov.gr), Lamia dog shelter (animals.lamia.gr, 24/7 for strays), Athens municipal clinic (news only). Athens 24-h leads NOT confirmed on own sites: Zoophilos Pangrati (no site found), Anastopoulos Ilioupoli (24κτηνιατρειο.gr not fetchable; added from ΣΚΜΖΑ without 24 h), A. Antonopoulos N.
